reason: Exact pre-run review found one cancellation-race implementation defect and one overly permissive missing-state rule. The running first integration attempt had not produced a strategy artifact or any observed fit/development outcome when this amendment was frozen; the branch update cancels that attempt.

corrections.opposite_trigger_search: After the first entry fills, same-side trade retriggers cannot terminate the search for the still-live opposite entry. Search only for the opposite threshold until the modeled cancel-effective boundary; if crossed, flatten with the adverse market fill.
corrections.feature_continuity: Every accepted decision requires all 600 completed 100ms midpoint states in the preceding 60 seconds to be fresh. A rolling feature never bridges an unavailable quote state.
corrections.fit_label_continuity: Every 30-second fit hazard label requires complete fresh midpoint coverage after activation. Labels with any unavailable 100ms state are excluded rather than inferred from partial paths.
corrections.exact_scan_optimization: Initial trigger, opposite trigger, target/stop and two-consecutive-state-exit searches use vectorized first-hit calculations. Target/stop is searched only through an earlier known state-exit boundary. This is an exact algorithmic acceleration and does not alter event ordering or prices.

adversarial_test_added: A same-side retrigger before a later opposite trigger must not hide a double-trigger flattening loss under the 300ms cancellation profile.
